description: This PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_ConfigSchema' constructs an HTMLPurifier configuration schema from an interchange representation, setting directives, allowed values, aliases, and post-processing the schema.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_ConfigSchema
classes.description: A builder class responsible for creating an HTMLPurifier configuration schema from an interchange object by iterating over directives and applying various schema configurations.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema object based on the provided interchange data, configuring directives, allowed values, aliases, and performing post-processing.
